title: Derivative of a truncated Boolean vector
statement: Let $w$ be a Boolean vector of length $n$, and let $k<n$. Encode its first $k$ bits as elements of $\mathbb{F}_2$ and set all later coordinates to zero. The derivative bit of this truncated vector at coordinate $k$ equals the sum in $\mathbb{F}_2$ of the encoded first $k$ bits of $w$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean vector of length $n$
